_about: Example scene -> look overrides for the optional content pack. Copy to scene_looks.json in the same directory to activate. Format: {"<scene name>": ["<makeup level>", "<hair style or null>"]}. Scene names must match the scene names used by your media generation flow (see scene_cards.md); makeup levels and hair styles should match the names defined in looks.md. Scenes not listed here fall back to the day's base look (daily_look). worker.py build_pack exposes the resolved table as pack.scene_look.
